title: IP-catalog configuration interchange
summary: Connected catalog and desktop configuration representations with metadata-aware Python adapters.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2022-01-24. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built Python adapters translating IP-catalog CCXML and engine YAML/JSON, reconstructing domain hierarchies, protocol mappings and interface clock relationships.
Used content hashes to avoid reimporting unchanged build datasets and added subprocess/error reporting for the historical catalog-to-desktop workflow.
Integration adapters date to 2022; the legacy launcher was deprecated in May 2024, so historical launcher functionality is not asserted as current supported architecture.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
